name: Peppermint Ice Cream
subtitle: Taysom contribution
notes: Little candy canes work best, and don’t crush too finely.

steps.title: Make the base
steps.body: Mix in saucepan: **¾ cup sugar** and **2 Tbsp cornstarch**. Gradually stir in: **3 cups whole milk**, **¾ cup corn syrup** and **2 eggs, lightly beaten**.

steps.title: Cook
steps.body: Cook over boiling water 10 minutes, or until thickened.

steps.title: Add cream and flavor
steps.body: Stir in: **1 cup heavy cream**, **⅛-¼ tsp peppermint extract** and **2 drops red food coloring**.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.body: Freeze in 2 quart or larger freezer.

steps.title: Add candy canes
steps.body: When mostly frozen, add: **1 to 1¼ cups crushed candy canes**.
